title: Studio Data › Actions: ticking "Expose to AI agents" writes a flat `aiExposed` key the spec refuses — every later save of the object answers 422 until reload, unticking does not recover
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

One click bricks the object editor: all subsequent autosaves are refused 422 unrecognized_keys `aiExposed`, and the builder sees edits not saving.

## Reproduction

1. Data › an object › Actions › an action › tick "Expose to AI agents" → autosave 422 unrecognized_keys `aiExposed`.
2. Untick → still 422. Any other edit on the object → 422 until reload.

## Expected

The control writes the nested `ai` block the spec defines (action.zod.ts ~1607), or is removed.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ActionDefaultInspector.tsx` (~lines 26, 381, 676, 1046).

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured by the Data QA card.
- Business reason: A single visible checkbox blocks all further work on the object; it is a protocol-refused shape written by the designer itself (p1 by the "designer systematically writes refused metadata" rule).
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:studio`, p1.
- Dedupe: semantic search `Expose to AI agents writes aiExposed unrecognized_keys action object save 422` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 1 hit (closed #3686, unrelated).
- QA id: U1
